rows.label: Concept
rows.text: The origin of life is explained by chemical evolution (abiogenesis). The Oparin-Haldane theory proposed that a reducing early atmosphere allowed inorganic molecules to form simple organics, then polymers, then proto-cells, then self-replicating life. The Miller-Urey experiment (1953) demonstrated that amino acids can form from inorganic precursors under early-Earth conditions.…

rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Chemical evolution: Inorganic (CH4, NH3, H2O, H2) → Simple organics (amino acids, sugars, bases) → Polymers → Proto-cells → Life
Miller-Urey: electric sparks (lightning) + reducing atmosphere → amino acids

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Abiogenesis ≠ spontaneous generation (spontaneous generation is the disproved idea that life arises from life daily; abiogenesis is the origin of life from non-life in primitive conditions).  ·  Miller-Urey proved organics CAN form from inorganics under early-Earth-like conditions; it did NOT prove life formed.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: NEB expects the Miller-Urey experiment (setup + results + significance) as a standard question.  ·  The Oparin-Haldane theory and its 4 stages are a frequent long-answer.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Miller-Urey (1953): electric discharge in CH4/NH3/H2O/H2 → glycine, alanine, aspartic acid.  ·  Oparin's coacervates: protein solutions form droplets that can take up substances from the environment.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: The early atmosphere was reducing (no free O2); free oxygen came later from photosynthetic cyanobacteria.  ·  Oparin (Russia) and Haldane (UK) independently proposed similar chemical-evolution theories.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: Chemical evolution  ·  Oparin-Haldane theory  ·  Miller-Urey experiment  ·  Reducing atmosphere

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: Oparin-Haldane: reducing early atmosphere allowed chemical evolution.  ·  Stages: simple organics → polymers → coacervates → self-replicating systems.  ·  Miller-Urey (1953): produced amino acids from inorganic precursors.  ·  RNA world: self-replicating, catalytic RNA may predate DNA/protein life.

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Life on Earth is estimated to be ~3.5–4 billion years old.  ·  The Miller-Urey apparatus produced amino acids in just one week.

rows.label: More practice
rows.text: What is the RNA world hypothesis?  ·  Differentiate abiogenesis from spontaneous generation.  ·  List three lines of evidence supporting chemical evolution.

rows.label: More hints
rows.text: List evidence supporting chemical evolution.  ·  Origin of Life is frequently tested.

rows.label: Extra solved
rows.text: RNA ribozymes (e.g., self-splicing introns) demonstrate RNA can catalyse its own replication.  ·  Hydrothermal vent microbes (chemoautotrophs) suggest life's earliest energy source may have been chemical, not solar.

rows.label: MCQ drill
rows.text: The Miller-Urey experiment produced: → B  ·  The Oparin-Haldane theory proposed that the early atmosphere was: → B

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: Origin of life: life arose from non-living matter by chemical evolution (abiogenesis) in a warm dilution (primordial ocean).  ·  Oparin-Haldane theory (1924/29): the early reducing atmosphere (CH4, NH3, H2O, H2, no O2) allowed formation of organic molecules from inorganic ones.  ·  Stages: (1) formation of simple organics (amino acids, nucleotides) → (2) polymers (proteins, nucleic acids) → (3) coacervates/microspheres (proto-cells) → (4) self-replicating systems.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: RNA world  ·  Abiogenesis vs spontaneous generation  ·  Coacervates

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: Hydrothermal vents  ·  Scientists believe that our planet, Earth, came into existence approximately four and a half billion years ago.  ·  During its formation, the entire solar system emerged from the condensation of cosmic dust and gases (According to Dust and cloud hypothesis).

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: At its birth, it was incredibly hot that everything existed as gases, making it impossible for any form of life to exist.  ·  Due to the extreme temperature, elements existed as individual atoms.  ·  Intense heat broke the bonds apart quickly and atoms couldn't bond together.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: Abiogenesis (origin of life) ≠ spontaneous generation (disproved).  ·  Evidence: lab synthesis, meteorites, hydrothermal vents.  ·  Coacervates (Oparin) and proteinoid microspheres (Fox) are models of proto-cells, not proven living cells.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: The RNA world is a hypothesis; it explains how self-replication and catalysis could coexist before DNA and proteins.  ·  Distinguish between key concepts in Origin of Life.  ·  Understand the differences between similar topics.
